title: Informed Consent
description: The child may not fully understand or provide informed consent for the transmission of their GPS coordinates, leading to potential misuse of their location data.

title: Data Leakage
description: The live GPS coordinates transmitted may be intercepted during transmission, leading to unauthorized access to the child's location.

title: Data Retention
description: The backend may retain the GPS data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or misuse.

title: Unintended Use of Data
description: The backend may use the GPS data for purposes other than originally intended, such as marketing or profiling, without the child's consent.

title: Location Data Leakage
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently expose sensitive location data when writing to the Location History Store, leading to unauthorized access or sharing of user location information.

title: Unauthorized Access to Location History
description: The Location History Store may be vulnerable to unauthorized access, allowing attackers to retrieve sensitive location data stored in the database.

title: Interception of Location Data
description: Location data being transmitted from the mobile app backend to the Location History Store could be intercepted by malicious actors during transit, leading to potential misuse of the data.

title: Location Data Exposure
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently expose sensitive location data when forwarding location pings to the Geofencing Engine, leading to potential unauthorized access to user location information.

title: Interception of Location Data
description: Location pings transmitted from the mobile app backend to the Geofencing Engine may be intercepted during transit, allowing unauthorized parties to access sensitive location information.

title: Improper Data Handling
description: The Geofencing & Alert Engine may improperly handle or store the received location data, leading to potential data breaches or misuse of sensitive information.

title: User Unawareness of Data Usage
description: Users may be unaware of how their location data is being used by the Geofencing & Alert Engine, leading to a lack of informed consent regarding data processing.

title: Unauthorized Access to Family Account Data
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the Family Account Store, leading to exposure of sensitive zone definitions.

title: Inaccurate Geofencing Alerts
description: If the Geofencing & Alert Engine processes incorrect or outdated zone definitions, it may trigger false alerts, leading to user confusion or panic.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: Zone definitions may be intercepted during transmission from the Family Account Store to the Geofencing & Alert Engine, leading to potential misuse of location data.

title: Unauthorized Data Sharing
description: The Geofencing Engine may inadvertently share location data with unauthorized parties, leading to privacy violations.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: The arrival/departure notifications could be intercepted during transmission, exposing sensitive location information.

title: Inadequate Data Protection at Destination
description: The Parent may not have adequate measures in place to protect the received location data, leading to potential misuse or unauthorized access.

title: Inadequate Consent
description: The parent may not fully understand what data is being collected or how it will be used, leading to inadequate consent for data sharing.

title: Data Misuse
description: The mobile app backend may misuse the child's profile data (name, DOB, school) for purposes other than intended, such as marketing or selling to third parties.

title: Insufficient Data Protection
description: The mobile app backend may not implement adequate security measures to protect the child's profile data from unauthorized access or breaches.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: Data transmitted from the parent to the mobile app backend may be intercepted, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Retention of Data Beyond Necessity
description: The mobile app backend may retain the child's profile data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure.

title: Unauthorized Access to Account Data
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently expose account data if proper authentication and authorization mechanisms are not in place, allowing unauthorized users to access sensitive information.

title: Data Breach of Stored Information
description: The Family Account & Permissions Store may be vulnerable to data breaches, leading to unauthorized access to child profiles and geofence zone data.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: Data being transmitted from the mobile app backend to the Family Account & Permissions Store could be intercepted by malicious actors, leading to potential exposure of sensitive information.

title: Informed Consent

title: Data Retention

title: Identity Disclosure

title: Unintended Use of Data
description: The mobile app backend may use the location data for purposes other than what the parent intended, such as marketing or analytics.

title: Unauthorized Access to Location Data

title: Insecure Data Processing
description: The mobile app backend may process the location history data insecurely, leading to potential exposure of sensitive information during processing.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: Location data may be intercepted during transmission from the data store to the mobile app backend, leading to unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Unintentional Data Sharing

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: Data being transmitted from the parent to the mobile app backend could be intercepted by unauthorized parties, leading to privacy breaches.

title: Inadequate Data Protection at Destination

title: Unclear User Consent

title: Unauthorized Access to Location Data
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently grant access to the secondary guardian without proper authentication or authorization checks, leading to unauthorized access to the child's live location data.

title: Misuse of Shared Location Data
description: The secondary guardian may misuse the child's live location data for purposes other than intended, such as stalking or harassment.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: The child's live location data may be intercepted during transmission from the backend to the secondary guardian, leading to potential privacy breaches.

title: Inadequate Data Minimization

title: Insecure Data Storage

title: Data Linkability
description: Aggregated data may still allow for the identification of individual users when combined with other data sources, leading to privacy concerns.

title: Misuse of Data
description: The advertising/analytics partner may use the shared data for purposes beyond what was agreed upon, such as targeted advertising without user consent.
